stdout:
Agent-optimized commands with TOON/JSON/Markdown output

Usage: am robot [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  agents        Agent roster with activity status, program, model
  analytics     Anomaly insights with severity, confidence, remediation commands
  atc           ATC snapshot: live server state with local DB fallback when unavailable
  attachments   Attachment inventory with type, size, provenance, storage mode
  contacts      Contact graph with policy surface, pending requests
  handoff       Stale bead ownership handoff dashboard with dry-run reopen recommendations
  health        System diagnostics synthesis (probes, DB pool, disk, anomalies)
  inbox         Actionable inbox with priority ordering, urgency/ack synthesis
  message       Single message with thread position, adjacent messages, sender info
  metrics       Tool performance summary (calls, errors, error%, latency percentiles)
  navigate      Resolve any resource:// URI and return in robot format
  overview      Cross-project unified summary (per-project unread/urgent/ack counts)
  projects      Project summary with per-project agent/message/reservation counts
  reservations  File reservations with TTL warnings, expiring-soon alerts, conflict detection
  search        Full-text search with facets and relevance scores
  status        Dashboard synthesis: health, inbox counts, activity, anomalies, reservations, top threads
  thread        Full conversation rendering for a thread
  timeline      Events since last check with temporal filters
  tui-dump      Non-interactive TUI snapshot dump — the I6 freeze escape hatch
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>    Output format: toon (default at TTY), json (default when piped), md (for thread/message)
      --json               Output JSON (shorthand for --format json)
      --project <PROJECT>  Project key (absolute path or slug). Falls back to AGENT_MAIL_PROJECT, then CWD
      --agent <AGENT>      Agent name. Falls back to AGENT_MAIL_AGENT, then AGENT_NAME
  -h, --help               Print help
